summary: Trust lookup and pre-commit hook check are now OS-aware pure functions (trustKeyMatch, hookCounts) with table tests for Windows, macOS and Linux; doctor and run's preflight use them.
verified: sh .vloop/state/gates/T8/gate.sh printed 'gate T8: ok'; go test ./internal/cli passes; GOOS=windows go build ./... ok.
notes: Hooks dir comes from git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path hooks. Trust matching iterates the ~/.claude.json keys and still tries the symlink-resolved root. Run go test ./internal/cli with VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 unset.
